list: The official 55-trophy list as published 2026-11-18 (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.guide: This is the platinum trophy, and it unlocks automatically once you have earned the other 54 trophies on this list. There is no extra task of its own: every story trophy, every activity, every collectible and the 100% completion gold all feed into it. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4 out of 10 in difficulty and estimates about 200 hours to the platinum, with no online trophies and no DLC required. Follow the roadmap in this guide — story first, activities and collectibles alongside it, then the cleanup phase — and this trophy pops when the last one does. Use the checklist here to track your progress toward it.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 and the trophy unlocks when the mission ends. It is the first story trophy and cannot be skipped: the mission is part of the main story path, so simply keep playing the story and it will pop. As with every story trophy, it is locked to this named mission — if you somehow passed it without the trophy registering, use mission replay if the game offers it, otherwise a new playthrough is the way back. Nothing else is needed: no side task, no collectible, no score to beat.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission of Chapter 1 and this trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. Chapters are the game's main story blocks, and this one closes once its last mission is complete, so just follow the story markers and do not worry about optional content yet. It is story-locked to Chapter 1: the only way to miss it is to stop playing the story, and if the trophy ever failed to register, mission replay (if available) or a new playthrough is the route back. PowerPyx notes the whole story runs about 60 to 80 hours across its chapters, so treat Chapter 1 as the opening stretch of a long road.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.guide: Complete every story mission in Chapter 2 and the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. Like the other chapter trophies it is automatic: there is no extra objective, score or collectible tied to it, only finishing the chapter's missions in order. It is story-locked to Chapter 2, so it can only be missed by not finishing the chapter, and the remedy if it ever failed to register is mission replay where available or a fresh playthrough. Keep the story moving and this one takes care of itself.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Finish all of Chapter 3's story missions and this trophy pops at the chapter's end. It is another automatic story trophy: no side activity or hidden requirement is attached to it, just the main story path through the chapter. It is story-locked to Chapter 3, so the only way to miss it is to leave the chapter unfinished, and mission replay (if available) or a new playthrough is the way back if it ever failed to register. By this point in the story you will have met the characters and places behind many of the side trophies, so it is a good moment to start the activities and collectibles alongside the story.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Complete every story mission of Chapter 4 and the trophy unlocks when the chapter ends. Like the other chapter trophies it asks nothing beyond playing the story through to the chapter's close, with no optional objective attached. It is story-locked to Chapter 4, so it can only be missed by not finishing the chapter; if it ever failed to register, use mission replay if the game offers it, otherwise a new playthrough. After Chapter 4 only the final mission stands between you and the story's end.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Finish the game's final mission and this gold trophy unlocks as the credits roll. It is the story's capstone: the only requirement is completing that last mission, with no score, time limit or side task attached. It is story-locked to the final mission, so it cannot be missed by any choice you make along the way — finishing the story is the whole requirement — and mission replay (if available) or a new playthrough is the remedy if it ever failed to register. Once it pops, the 100% completion checklist opens up for the post-game cleanup, and the platinum is within reach.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Play through the story mission Breakfast Run to its end and this trophy unlocks when the mission completes. It is a named-mission story trophy, so it is automatic once the mission is done: no extra objective, no grade to earn, no optional step. It is story-locked to Breakfast Run, which means it can only be missed if the mission itself is left unfinished or if the trophy fails to register — in that case use mission replay if the game offers it, otherwise a new playthrough. Keep following the story markers and it will come naturally.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist and this trophy unlocks at the mission's end. Like every named-mission trophy it is automatic: finishing the heist is the whole requirement, with no score to chase and no optional objective attached. It is story-locked to The Cartel Heist, so the only way to miss it is to leave the mission unfinished, and mission replay (if available) or a new playthrough is the way back if it ever failed to register. Heist missions tend to be long, so set aside time and follow the mission's own objectives step by step.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play and this trophy unlocks when the mission ends. It is a named-mission story trophy, so finishing the mission is the entire requirement — no extra objective, no grade, no collectible. It is story-locked to Child's Play, which means it can only be missed if the mission is left unfinished or the trophy fails to register; mission replay (if available) or a new playthrough is the remedy. Just follow the story and it will pop on its own.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners and this trophy unlocks at the mission's end. It is automatic once the mission is finished: the trophy asks for nothing beyond playing Headliners through to completion. It is story-locked to Headliners, so the only way to miss it is to leave the mission unfinished, and mission replay (if available) or a new playthrough is the way back if it ever failed to register. Keep to the story path and this one is guaranteed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown and this trophy unlocks when the mission ends. VCIA is the airport, so expect this mission to take place in and around it, but the trophy itself asks for nothing beyond finishing the mission. It is story-locked to VCIA Takedown: it can only be missed if the mission is left unfinished or the trophy fails to register, in which case use mission replay if available or start a new playthrough. Play the mission through and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory and this trophy unlocks at the mission's end. It is the last of the named-mission story trophies, and like the others it is automatic: finishing the mission is the whole requirement, with no score or optional objective attached. It is story-locked to Operation Savage Glory, so it can only be missed if the mission is left unfinished or the trophy fails to register; mission replay (if available) or a new playthrough is the remedy. Once it pops, only the final mission remains in the story.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's completion checklist, which opens after the story is finished, and this gold trophy unlocks. PowerPyx calls it the hardest trophy in the set, but also notes the checklist is lenient: it is closer to 60% of true completion, with most side quests not required and collectibles only partly required. The checklist is a bundle of thresholds across the game's activities — stunts, races, collectibles, stranger missions and more — and most of its progress comes from earning the other trophies in this guide. Work through the roadmap's Phase 3 cleanup, ticking off the checklist items one by one, and the gold pops when the last one lands. Nothing on the checklist is missable, so it can all be done after the credits.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts across Leonida and this silver trophy unlocks. PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in total, split into four kinds: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps with a parachute. Any mix counts, so pick the kinds you enjoy and the ones near where you already are — jumps and bridge flights are the easiest to rack up in bulk. The 100% completion checklist needs 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 and the extra 50 count toward the gold. Stunts are tracked by the game as you do them, so you can chip away at this one across the whole playthrough.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity in the game once and this bronze trophy unlocks. The game's tracker counts 9 activity types, and you can see them under Progress, then Activities, in the pause menu — PowerPyx notes the same path. The activities include the ones behind other trophies in this guide, such as fishing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games and bowling, so working through the activity trophies naturally covers most of the nine. Simply start one of each type; you do not need to win, finish or score well, just try it. Check the Activities screen to see which types you still have left.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge and this silver trophy unlocks. The trophy tracker counts 42 challenges, so this is a long grind rather than a single lucky run: each challenge is a timed shooting test, and gold means beating its top score threshold. Work through them weapon by weapon, learning each challenge's layout before going for gold, and use the range's own scoring feedback to see how close you are. There is no shortcut — every one of the 42 needs gold — so treat it as a steady project across the playthrough rather than a single sitting. The range is an activity type too, so it also counts toward Master of None.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of its locations and this bronze trophy unlocks. The trophy tracker counts 14 drone race locations across Leonida, so you will need to find each race spot and take first place there. Drone races are flying challenges — learn each course's line before pushing for the win, and remember that only a win at a location counts, not just taking part. Work through the locations as you explore the map, ticking them off one by one, and the trophy pops when the last location is won. Like the other race trophies, this also feeds the 100% completion checklist.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races and this bronze trophy unlocks. The key word is different: winning the same race twenty times does not count, so you need to win twenty separate races across Leonida's race types — street races, drone races, boat races and whatever else the map offers. Race events are scattered around the state, so explore and take each one as you find it, and use the win to tick it off in this guide's checklist. The Top Fun drone race wins count toward this total as well, so the two race trophies progress together. Nothing here is missable, so you can sweep up any races you skipped after the story.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge and this bronze trophy unlocks. Cal is the fishing rival you meet through the game's fishing activity, so first find a fishing spot and take part in the challenge against him — the activity itself is one of the nine types that count toward Master of None. Fishing challenges are scored on the catch, so learn the fishing mechanics first with a few casual sessions before challenging Cal. Once you out-fish him in a challenge, the trophy pops. Nothing about this is missable: Cal and the fishing spots stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game and this bronze trophy unlocks. Arcade machines are found in arcades and other venues around Leonida, so head to one, pick any game on offer, and play it through to its end. You do not need a high score or a perfect run — just a completion — so choose the game you find easiest and finish it. The arcade is one of the nine activity types, so this also counts toward Master of None. If you fail a run, simply try again: arcade games stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work through Andy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it, and this bronze trophy unlocks. Andy is one of the side characters who gives you a chain of missions outside the main story, and each mission in the chain unlocks the next, so keep accepting Andy's calls and jobs until the strand reaches its end. Side-character strands are not missable: they stay open after the story, so you can finish Andy's chain whenever you like. The final mission is the last job in that chain, and completing it closes the strand and pops the trophy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Work through Kenton's mission strand to its final mission and complete it, and this bronze trophy unlocks. Kenton is another side character with a chain of missions, and the chain works the same way as the others: each mission you finish opens the next one, until the final mission closes the strand. The strand is not missable, so you can take it at your own pace and finish it after the story if you prefer. Keep an eye out for Kenton's missions on the map and in your contacts, and complete the last one to earn the trophy.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Work through Billy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it, and this bronze trophy unlocks. Billy's chain is one of several side-character strands in the game: missions arrive one at a time, and finishing each one opens the next until the strand ends with its final mission. The strand is not missable and stays available after the story, so there is no rush to finish it in any particular chapter. Follow Billy's missions to the end and the trophy pops when the final one is complete.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight stranger mission strands across Leonida and this silver trophy unlocks. Strangers are the game's side characters — people you meet out in the world who offer a chain of missions, like Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, whose own final-mission trophies are also on this list. Each strand is a short series of missions, and a strand only counts once you have finished all of its missions. You need eight complete strands, so work through every stranger you meet rather than just one or two. Stranger strands are not missable, so you can finish them in the post-game cleanup, but starting them early spreads the work across the playthrough.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Work through Randy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it, and this bronze trophy unlocks. Randy's chain is another stranger strand: missions come one at a time, and each completed mission opens the next until the final mission closes the strand. The strand is not missable and remains available after the story, so finish it whenever suits you. Randy's strand also counts as one of the eight needed for the Strangers & Freaks silver, so completing it pulls double duty toward the platinum.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Work through Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission and complete it, and this bronze trophy unlocks. Tyrone's chain follows the same pattern as the other stranger strands: a series of missions, each opening the next, ending with a final mission that closes the strand. It is not missable, so you can complete it at any point, including after the story. Like the other side-character trophies, it also counts as one of the eight strands needed for Strangers & Freaks, so it moves two trophies forward at once.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida and this bronze trophy unlocks. The trophy tracker counts 18 spots, spread across the state, and you must meditate at each one. This is the one trophy other guides flag as potentially missable: PowerPyx reports that the first meditation spot is offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter, so do that first meditation as soon as it is offered and do not leave Chapter 1 without it. After Chapter 1, work through the remaining spots as you explore, using the map to find each one. Meditating is a quiet activity, so pair it with your exploration of each new area.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for and this bronze trophy unlocks. Bret is the hunting contact, and the hunt works like the game's other animal encounters: find the animal in its habitat, track it, and take it down. PowerPyx notes the 100% completion checklist asks you to study 100 of the game's 255 animals by looking at them through binoculars, so carry binoculars on the hunt and study animals as you go — the two goals progress together. The hunt is not missable and stays available after the story, so take your time and prepare before you go after a unique animal.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.guide: Complete three full sets of collectible cards and this silver trophy unlocks. Collectible cards are hidden around Leonida, and each set is a group of cards that belong together — a set only counts once every card in it is found. Explore thoroughly and pick up every card you spot, checking each area as you pass through it, and keep an in-game count of which sets are nearly done. You only need three complete sets, not every card in the game, so focus on finishing the sets you are closest to completing. Cards are a pure collectible: nothing about them is missable, so a post-game sweep can finish any set you started.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations across Leonida and this silver trophy unlocks. WAiNK is the game's in-world photo-sharing feature: at marked locations you can take and share a shot, and each location only counts once. That means this trophy is a tour of the state — visit 100 distinct WAiNK spots, take the photo at each, and the count climbs. Pair it with your exploration: every time you enter a new area, look for its WAiNK spot before moving on. Nothing here is missable, so you can finish the last few locations in a post-game sweep of the map.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 challenges and this bronze trophy unlocks. Challenges are the game's open-world goals — small tasks scattered across Leonida that the game tracks in its challenges list, covering driving, shooting, exploration and more. You do not need to do any particular fifty: pick the ones that suit how you play and the ones near where you already are, and the count climbs as you go. PowerPyx notes the 100% completion checklist needs 70 of the game's 80 challenges, so keep going past 50 — the extra twenty count toward the gold. Check the challenges list in the pause menu to see which ones you are close to finishing.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level and then lose it, and this bronze trophy unlocks. The partner is the other protagonist — Jason or Lucia — so this needs a moment when you are together in free roam, not a solo session. Raise the heat by committing crimes until the wanted level hits four stars, then break line of sight, hide, and stay out of the search area until the stars clear. Four stars brings serious police attention, so plan your escape route before you start: a fast car, a quiet hiding spot, and a partner who is still with you when the heat dies. Once the wanted level is gone, the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level, and this bronze trophy unlocks. The trick is the middle of the sentence: you must keep the wanted level alive the whole time, so do not let the heat die between robberies. Plan a route with three shops close together, hit them one after another with your partner along, and keep moving between them so the police stay on your tail but never catch you. Three quick robberies, no gap in the wanted level, and the trophy pops after the third. If the heat dies between shops, the chain resets and you start again.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles and this bronze trophy unlocks. Discovery means finding a vehicle type in the world — driving past it, seeing it on the street, or scanning it — and the game tracks each distinct vehicle you encounter. PowerPyx notes the 100% completion checklist asks you to scan 200 of the game's 277 base model vehicles, so this trophy is the first third of that longer goal: keep discovering and scanning vehicles as you explore, and both counts climb together. Variety is what matters, so visit different areas — city streets, the countryside, the coast — because each has vehicles the others do not. Nothing here is missable, so keep the count growing across the whole playthrough.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one use of Combat Focus and this bronze trophy unlocks. Combat Focus is the game's slow-motion aiming mode, and it lasts only a short time, so you need five enemies close together and a plan before you trigger it. Find a spot with a group of enemies — a gang hideout or a mission firefight with several hostiles in view — then activate Combat Focus and take them down one by one while time is slowed. Five in a single use is the requirement, so a quiet street with one or two enemies will not do it; wait for a crowd. If the focus ends before the fifth, try again: the trophy only counts a single use.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from VCIA — the airport — and this bronze trophy unlocks. An unscheduled departure means leaving the airport by air without a ticket or a flight plan: get yourself a plane at VCIA and take off. The simplest way is to find an aircraft on the airfield, get in, and fly out of the airport's airspace. Expect airport security and police attention on the ground, so move fast once you are on the tarmac and get airborne before the heat builds. Once you are up and away from VCIA, the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: This trophy is about the Rhino tank: get into one and put it to use, and the trophy unlocks. Rhinos are military vehicles, so they are not sitting on a normal street — look for them at military sites or in missions where the army shows up, and be ready for a heavy police and military response when you take one. The trophy's own description is a joke about how hot it gets inside a tank, and the requirement is simply to get into a Rhino and use it. Once you are in the driver's seat and rolling, the trophy pops. It is not missable: tanks stay available in the world after the story.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected and this bronze trophy unlocks. The key is stealth: get in, take the goods, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. Plan the approach — go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, and do not let a guard or a customer spot you. If you are detected, the attempt fails, so leave and try again rather than fighting your way out. A quiet, quick robbery with no alarm is what the trophy wants, so patience beats speed here.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape from each one, and this silver trophy unlocks. Bank vaults are the game's big robberies: each one is a planned job with a vault to crack and a getaway to make, and the trophy counts only the vaults you rob and escape from cleanly. Work through them one at a time, planning the escape route before you go in — a fast car, a clear road, and a plan for losing the police once the alarm is up. Five successful vault jobs with clean escapes is the requirement, so a failed getaway does not count. Nothing here is missable: the vaults stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape, and this bronze trophy unlocks. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida, so find one on the road, stop it, and take its cargo — the classic approach is to block it, force it open, and grab the money. The escape is the second half of the trophy: once the truck is robbed, the police will be after you, so have a getaway car ready and a route planned before you strike. Lose the heat and the trophy pops. Armored trucks keep running after the story, so this is never missable.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Explore every area of Leonida and this bronze trophy unlocks. The trophy tracker counts 52 areas, and an area counts once you have set foot in it and the game registers it as discovered. The state is large — Vice City, the coast, the swamps and the countryside — so this trophy is a tour: drive, fly and walk into every corner of the map, and watch the area counter climb. Pair it with your other exploration trophies, like the WAiNK locations and the meditation spots, so one trip through an area ticks several goals at once. Nothing here is missable, so a post-game sweep of the map finishes whatever is left.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of Leonida's gangs and this bronze trophy unlocks. The trophy tracker counts 9 gangs, and you need to hit one illegal operation for every one of them — a different gang each time, not nine hits on the same gang. Illegal operations are the gangs' off-the-books businesses, marked in the world as robbable targets, so find one per gang, rob it, and escape. Work through the gangs one by one, keeping a note of which ones you have already hit. Nothing here is missable: the operations stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy it with the view, and this bronze trophy unlocks. Ocean Beach is the beachfront strip in Vice City, and the trophy is a quiet moment rather than a challenge: find a bar or venue on the beach, sit down with a drink, and take in the ocean. No skill, score or time limit is involved — just be at the right place and order the cocktail. It is a good trophy to grab while you are exploring Vice City, and it is never missable, so it can wait until a calm moment after the story.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style and this bronze trophy unlocks. The classic style is the old-school move: take a car inside a showroom and drive it straight through the glass and out onto the street. Find a vehicle showroom with cars on display, get behind the wheel of one, and floor it through the frontage. The trophy is about the spectacle — a dramatic exit through the glass — so do not be subtle about it. It is never missable: showrooms stay open after the story, so you can stage the smash whenever you like.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, bowl, and follow through on your throw, and this bronze trophy unlocks. Bowling is one of the game's activities, and this trophy is tied to that specific alley: find it, start a game, and play through your throws. Follow-through is the bowling term for completing your delivery after the ball leaves your hand, so the trophy is really asking you to bowl properly at this alley rather than just visit it. Play a game there and the trophy pops. Bowling is also one of the nine activity types, so it counts toward Master of None too.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: This trophy is about the partnership between the two protagonists, Jason and Lucia, and the way their story plays out to a wide audience. It unlocks through the story as their partnership reaches a milestone the game marks with this trophy, so there is no separate task to hunt down — keep playing the main story and it will pop when the moment arrives. The description is deliberately vague because the trophy is tied to a story beat, and the spoiler setting in this guide hides story trophies until they are earned for exactly that reason. If it has not popped, you have not reached that story moment yet; keep following the story markers.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: This trophy is about the choices you make during the game, and it unlocks once you have made enough of them. GTA VI gives you decisions to make — in conversations, in missions, in how you approach a job — and the game tracks them. Keep playing and making choices as they come, and the trophy pops when the count is reached. There is no single choice to hunt down and no wrong answer to avoid: the trophy is a tally of the decisions across your playthrough. If it has not popped yet, you simply have not made enough choices, so keep playing.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: This trophy is about succeeding on a second attempt: fail at something, then get it right the next time, and the trophy unlocks. The game tracks attempts at activities and missions, so a failed run followed by a successful retry is what it wants. The most reliable way is to attempt a challenge or mission, fail it, and then complete it on the very next try — the trophy is tied to that second-time success. It is not missable: there are plenty of retryable activities in the game, from races to shooting challenges, so if it has not popped, try failing a short activity once and then beating it immediately after.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: This trophy is about witnessing something strange in Leonida, and it unlocks when you stumble across one of the game's odd, hidden moments. The description is deliberately vague — it is a hidden trophy whose trigger is an unusual event out in the world, the kind of thing you find by exploring rather than by following a marker. Keep your eyes open while you explore: strange encounters, odd sights and unexpected events are scattered around the state, and one of them is what this trophy wants. It is not missable, so keep exploring after the story and it will turn up. If you are hunting it deliberately, sweep the map's quieter corners and watch for anything out of place.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by and this bronze trophy unlocks. A melee drive-by means striking someone with a melee weapon while you are in a moving vehicle — a swing from a car window or a bike, not a gun. Find a pedestrian, get a vehicle moving alongside them at a good speed, and land the melee hit as you pass. The target needs to be bowled over by the blow, so speed and timing matter: too slow and it is just a tap, too fast and you will miss. Try it on a quiet street where you can line up the pass, and keep trying until the hit lands cleanly. It is not missable: it can be done anywhere, any time.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts and this bronze trophy unlocks. Marked bills are dirty money you pick up from robberies and jobs, and your contacts are the people who can wash them into clean cash for a cut. The process is gradual: each laundering run converts a batch of marked bills, and the trophy tracks the total you have earned this way. Keep robbing and laundering as you play — bank vaults, armored trucks and shop robberies all feed the pile of marked bills — and the $250,000 total climbs. It is not missable, so the money keeps coming after the story.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across the game's shops and this bronze trophy unlocks. Every purchase counts — clothes, weapons, ammo, food, vehicle upgrades — as long as it is bought in a shop, and the total is cumulative across all of them. You will spend a lot naturally across a full playthrough, but if you want to speed it up, buy the big-ticket items: weapons, vehicle mods and property upgrades add up fast. Check your spending total in the game's stats to see how close you are. It is not missable, so keep shopping after the story and the $100,000 mark will fall.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property in the game and this bronze trophy unlocks. The trophy tracker counts 8 garage properties, spread around Leonida, and each one is bought with in-game money through the property market. Garages are useful as well as collectible: they give you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for the Whip It Good trophy, so buy them as you find them rather than leaving them all to the end. Save up across the playthrough — robberies, missions and laundered money all help — and buy each garage when you can afford it. Once the eighth is yours, the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app and this bronze trophy unlocks. Scooter Bros is the game's vehicle app: when you find a vehicle you like, you can register it there, and the trophy counts ten registrations. Any ten vehicles count, so register the ones you drive most and the ones you discover while exploring — variety is not required, just the count. Registration is quick, so this is one of the easiest trophies on the list once you know the app exists. Pair it with the vehicle discovery trophy: every new vehicle you find is another one you can register.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list (2026-11-18) via Exophase / PSNProfiles
